name: Horrifique Chtonien
description: Prophète du Néant annonçant la fin imminente du cycle cosmique actuel démoralisant durablement les forces ennemies.

subject.archetype: Horrifique Chtonien — Éveil Chthonien Epic obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes altérées par l'exposition aux énergies chthoniennes. Peaux pâles translucides avec runes sombres. Yeux entièrement noirs. Ombres détachées., refined faction craftsmanship
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's decrease ability (opposite_side) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Epic combat manifestation character unleashing their signature ability at maximum power with full body commitment — Dimensional pressure pushing against cards on the opposite side of the board

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Bone White

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi-source dramatic lighting: primary glow from the ability effect itself, secondary rim light, environmental reflections from below

camera.angle: low extreme angle with wide lens emphasizing the character's dominance over the environment

scenography.setting: Ancient underground temple with impossible non-Euclidean geometry, walls covered in carved forbidden symbols, massive sealed portal doors radiating dark energy
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Eerie pulsating purple fog along the ground, shadow tendrils detaching and reattaching, pulsating ancient runes glowing intermittently, warped light bending unnaturally, plus force field — visible compression field squeezing opposition values down visible in the environment
